verdict.rationale: NotebookLM generates AI-driven insights and suggestions directly from uploaded sources — auto-generated summaries, grounded chat with citations, mind maps, study guides, infographics, quizzes, and audio/video overviews that synthesize connections across sources. Community evidence corroborates real usage (e.g., podcast overviews, study aid use) though with some UX complaints about interactivity and format rigidity. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of insight quality/accuracy and evidence of proactive/agentic suggestion-making beyond source-grounded generation.
